scope: Read-only audit of formal-01, public archive, recorded no-Claude-PATH full rescore, and RESULTS.md. No new models, candidate execution, regeneration, or source/record edits by auditor.

requirements.basis: Case inventory and requirement mapping independently reconstructed from the frozen trusted oracle; this is not proof of exhaustive correctness.

model_usage_interpretation: Every observed assistant model is claude-opus-5-5. Haiku occurs only in CLI modelUsage accounting; these traces do not establish its internal role. Terminal usage matches Opus fields, while total_cost_usd includes both models. Cost basis is list, not an invoice.
limits: No replacement is visible in the frozen campaign: 40 schedule entries, 40 launch files, 40 unique sessions, 40 records, no extra run directory. Local logs cannot disprove unrecorded external calls.
Freeze timing is supported by local manifest/launch timestamps and linked hashes, not an external timestamp authority.
Evaluation source/candidate/requirements hashes and all case outcomes were checked. Evaluation file hashes are captured at audit time, not evidence of a prior signed ledger.
Forty accepted artifacts do not measure maintainability, human review time, production reliability, arm equivalence, runtime Skill efficacy, or full agent loops.
The 180 pairs reuse 40 files; high cosine can reflect shared seed and coarse representation. No comparative estimator or new inferential contrast is produced.
Exact 95% intervals per arm assume a stable independent Bernoulli process; N=10 lower bound is 0.025^(1/10), not a pass^10 reliability estimate.
Real repository source is provenance, not proof of human authorship. Case/reference/mutation fixtures are authored apparatus, not humans or empirical baseline runs.
Raw thinking/content was parsed only in memory as necessary; output artifacts contain no thinking text.
